OFFICE No. NOTE 01. 02.03.2026 Dr.YLR,

J  I.A.No.01 of 2026  in  Crl.P.No.1666 of 2026  Heard.
 Dispensed with for the present.
Dr.YLR,J  Crl.P.Nos.1666 and 1679 of 2026  Heard Sri Posani Venkateswarlu, the learned  Senior Counsel, representing Mr.Posani Akash,

the  learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned  Assistant Public Prosecutor.
 Issue notice to respondent No.2.
The learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice on respondent No.2 and file proof to that effect.

Respondent No.2, who is the husband of Petitioner No.1, has lodged an FIR in Cr.No.388 of 2024 on the file of Duvvada Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 312, 494, 448,
323, 506, 384 read with 511 and 34 of 'the IPC'.

Petitioner No.1/wife/Accused No.1 has lodged a complaint with the Women Police Station, Contd...
Visakhapatnam, on 23.08.2021, which was registered as Cr.No.404 of 2021 for the offences punishable under Section 498-A of 'the IPC' and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961.
Petitioner No.1 has also instituted a complaint in D.V.C.No.02 of 2022 on the file of the learned III Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Gajuwaka.

entities.text: III Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Gajuwaka
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Insofar as the alleged offence punishable under Section 494 of 'the IPC' is concerned, there is a bar contemplated under Section 198 of 'the Cr.P.C'.
The husband/Respondent No.2 has also instituted divorce proceedings against the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be a stay of all further proceedings in C.C.No.358 of 2025 on the file of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gajuwaka,

Ms. Kanagala Radhika, learned trained mediator, is appointed as mediator in this case.

The Station House Officer, Duvvada Police Station, is directed to secure the presence of the parties before the learned mediator on 30.03.2026.

The petitioners and Respondent No.2 are directed to appear before the mediator on 30.03.2026 and cooperate with the mediation Contd...
